newsitem.title: USA: Aztec Manufacturing sees Q3 EPS, sales gain.
newsitem.headline: Aztec Manufacturing sees Q3 EPS, sales gain.

text.p: Aztec Manufacturing Co said it expects to report about a 55 percent rise in both its third-quarter earnings per share and net income, as well as a 10 percent rise in sales over the year-ago quarter.

The company said the improved results stem from its onging program of acquisitions in the galvanizing services arena, and both good economic conditions and internal restructurings that have led to more electrical-product sales.
The company earned $732,000, or $0.13 a share, in last year's third quarter on revenue of $12,975,000.
